heading: Engineer, AI enthusiast, reluctant on-call person.

photo.alt: Well, that's not suppose to happen

bio: I’m an Associate SDET and AI Engineer based in Bengaluru. I build AI-powered systems, developer tools, and automation that turn repetitive engineering work into reliable, autonomous workflows.

My work spans AI agents, RAG, computer vision, test automation, and full-stack development. I’m particularly interested in what happens when you combine AI reasoning with solid software engineering—systems that don’t just generate answers, but actually get things done.
Outside work I write about what breaks in production and how we fixed it. Some of those notes are on the [blog](/blog).
